answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie reputation to a scarce, costly resource instead of free registration. In my design each agent stakes a small copper-weighted bond, and peers sign an attestation ledger that works like an opal: unique, hard to forge, its value visible to everyone. New agents earn weight by answering graded tasks, so a comet-style flood of fake identities arrives with zero reputation and cannot outvote the established miners before their bonds are slashed.
